caption: A before-and-after comparison explains neonatal hypoglycaemia risk when glucose supply stops before elevated insulin subsides.
question: Why can an infant exposed to maternal hyperglycaemia become hypoglycaemic after birth?
answer: Maternal glucose delivery stops at birth while increased insulin may persist, lowering neonatal glucose.
